prerequisites.instruction: Use this host's eligible Marketplace or internal app, fixed client ID, protected client secret and registered redirect URI. Unlisted distributed apps are not eligible; do not borrow another client registration.
Obtain any workspace installation approval and confirm app eligibility and network restrictions with its administrator.
Select the intended Slack user and workspace explicitly; observe the actual authenticated account before use.

Let the existing credential owner complete provider user OAuth. For channel/thread reads choose the applicable channels:history, groups:history, im:history or mpim:history scopes; search/send have different scopes and are not implicitly granted. No token, client secret or callback secret belongs in metadata.
Bind freshly observed tool schemas, selected operations, account, policy and lifecycle through the existing host owners; an endpoint string is not readiness.

blockers: No host registration, OAuth callback or selected account binding is retained.
Current schema, operation, authorization, lifecycle and readiness receipts are still needed; there is intentionally no executable mcp.json in this version.

prerequisites.instruction: Select the repository Python SlackOperations source or a locally built and verified private wheel described in SUPPORT.md. Python >=3.11 and the local slack extra are required; this is not a public release instruction.
Use the host's Slack Web API app registration and approved OAuth redirect handling. Choose the required user_scope or bot scope for this installation; MCP eligibility is a separate route requirement.
Confirm app approval, conversation access and the applicable installation rate-limit class with the workspace owner.

The host supplies a dedicated authenticated AsyncClient and exact API base for one selected workspace/account. Select supported token type and relevant channels:history, groups:history, im:history or mpim:history scopes for each method/resource; do not assume a token prefix or scope alone grants visibility.

Supply exact conversation IDs and thread timestamps from an authorized source. History access depends on the token subject and membership; validate replies access for the selected token and conversation too.

Bind the two read operations through existing service/auth/lifecycle owners. Plan pagination and threads explicitly, honor rate-limit responses, and do not claim complete weekly retrieval from a single page.

blockers: A verified local operation library is not an agent tool registration or activated service export.
Host OAuth/token lifecycle, exact account/resource authorization and operation bindings are not supplied.
No automatic channel discovery, full pagination, thread expansion, search or send is implemented in this slice.
